candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: LiDAR Composite and SurfZone DEM download spatial metadata index in GeoPackage
verified_facts: LiDAR Composite and SurfZone DEM download zip files now include a spatial metadata index in GeoPackage format.
The index describes the spatial location and temporal extent of the raster elevation data.
Technical guides describe the format and attribute schema of the index files.
semantic_limits: A GeoPackage index proves catalogue provenance fields only; parcel measurement still requires an exact tile/survey join and the actual raster sample used by the SHA-bound result.

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: Survey Data Catalogue - ASCII to GeoTiffs
verified_facts: EA changed 1m and 2m DTM Composite delivery from ASCII to GeoTIFF.
GeoTIFF files are supplied in 5km tiles with elevations in metres.
EA describes GeoTIFF as an open GIS format and notes it supports web services including WCS.
semantic_limits: A container-format migration from ASCII to GeoTIFF is not evidence that elevation values changed or improved; byte/sample provenance must be checked independently.
